parties: Pankaj Bajaj; Eldeco Housing and Industries Limited
headline: Pankaj Bajaj files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in Eldeco Housing
sum: Pankaj Bajaj has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), signalling a substantial acquisition event or change in shareholding above the prescribed threshold in Eldeco Housing and Industries Limited.
detail: Pankaj Bajaj has submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory when a person or entity acquires or agrees to acquire shares or voting rights in a listed company in such manner as to result in a change in control or crossing of prescribed thresholds. The filing initiates the regulatory gateway for evaluating whether an open offer, exemption or other remedial action is warranted under the Takeover Code.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 — Regulation 31(4)
triggers.note: Disclosure mandatory upon acquisition crossing 5% threshold or other notifiable event; non-filing or delayed filing attracts regulatory action.
If acquisition results in change of control or crosses 25%/51%, open offer obligation arises unless exemption (e.g., creeping or inter-se) is claimed and approved.
